title: Reference General Support chart includes four unrelated expenditure functions
evidence: The task requires rows that 'belong to the General Support Services function' and percentages of total General Support expenditure. The input identifies nine such items in 'General Exp Page 4' rows 19–27, totaling $57,389,846.70. However, the reference workbook's bottom chart uses '4'!C15:C27 and D15:D27: 13 items totaling $64,262,879.30. It additionally includes 'Maintenance of Plant', 'Community Services', 'Debt Services', and 'Other Misc', which the source statements classify separately. This changes every bottom-chart percentage. The rubric's reference-equivalence criterion can therefore conflict with a substantively correct nine-slice answer; its instruction-priority caveat does not correct the erroneous reference.
confirmation: Same confirmed defect: the reference General Support pie has 13 items summing to 64.26M instead of the 9 General Support items in 'General Exp Page 4'!B19:B27 (57.39M), so every slice percentage differs from a correct answer.
fix: Reference gt_122_ref_0.xlsx: the bottom General Support Services pie (chart6.xml) now plots only the 9 General Support Services items, '4'!C15:C23 / D15:D23 (Board Office through Operation of Plant, total 57,389,846.70). The four other functions (Maintenance of Plant, Community Services, Debt Services, Other Misc) are gone, with their cached points, dPt and dLbl entries removed. The helper percentages '4'!K15:K23 now divide by SUM($D$15:$D$23) instead of D29 (e.g. Operation of Plant 32%, School Adm 24%), K24:K27 are cleared, and calcChain is updated to match. Direct XML edit, no other cell or chart changed. The LibreOffice render shows the 9-slice pie.

title: The answer key's General Support Services pie includes four rows from other functions
evidence: The task says to use 'all rows that belong to the General Support Services function in the detailed table'. The source's own structure defines that function: 'Comb Rev & Expend Page 2' groups only rows 24-32 under 'GENERAL SUPPORT SERVICES:' (Board Office through Operation of Plant), with a subtotal in K32 of 130,915,235.42. Sheet '3' C18 also sums D24:D32. But the answer key's chart6.xml (sheet 'Exp by Fun Gen Support Chart5') points at '4'!$C$15:$C$27 and '4'!$D$15:$D$27. That is 13 slices, including Maintenance of Plant (5,958,793.08), Community Services (220,456.35), Debt Services (653,596.46) and Other Misc (40,186.71). These are separate functions with their own slices in the top All Funds chart. The percentages in the key's sheet 4 K15:K27 divide by D29 = 64,262,879.30 instead of the true General Support Services total of 57,389,846.70 (General Fund) or 130,915,235.42 (All Funds). In the rendered key, Operation of Plant shows 29% (correct General Fund share: 31.96%), School Adm 21% (correct: 23.73%), Maintenance of Plant 9% (should not appear). A correct submission with the 9 true items will not match the key on half of the deliverable. With a 0/1 single score, that will likely make it fail.

fix: Reference gt_122_ref_0.xlsx: the bottom General Support Services pie (chart6.xml) now plots only the 9 General Support Services items, '4'!C15:C23 / D15:D23 (Board Office through Operation of Plant, total 57,389,846.70). The four other functions (Maintenance of Plant, Community Services, Debt Services, Other Misc) are gone, with their cached points, dPt and dLbl entries removed. The helper percentages '4'!K15:K23 now divide by SUM($D$15:$D$23) instead of D29 (e.g. Operation of Plant 32%, School Adm 24%), K24:K27 are cleared, and calcChain is updated to match. title: Ambiguity and ground-truth contradiction regarding source table, columns, and row scope for the bottom pie chart ('breakdown of General Support Services')
evidence:
In `problem.py:5`, the prompt states: 'The bottom pie chart should show the "breakdown of General Support Services". Use the amounts for all rows that belong to the General Support Services function in the detailed table, calculate each item’s percentage of the total General Support Services amount, and make each item one slice.' However, in the workbook (`122_src_0.xlsx`), there are three different tables/scopes that contain 'General Support Services':
1. Sheet `Comb Rev & Expend Page 2`: Under `B23: GENERAL SUPPORT SERVICES:`, there are 9 sub-items in `C24:C32` (`Board Office`, `General Administration`, `School Administration`, `Facilities Acquisition & Construction`, `Fiscal Services`, `Food Services`, `Central Services`, `Pupil Transportation Services`, `Operation of Plant`), with All-Funds totals in `J24:J32` summing to `K32 = 130,915,235.42` (which matches Sheet `1` cell `C16: General Support Services = 'Comb Rev & Expend Page 2'!K32`) and General Fund amounts in `D24:D32` summing to `57,389,846.70`.
2. Sheet `General Exp Page 4`: Under `A18: General Support Services:`, the same 9 sub-items appear in `B19:B27`, with YTD Actual in `I19:I27` summing to `I28: Total General Support = 57,389,846.70`.
3. Sheet `4`: An unlabeled helper sheet where cell `D5` (the column D header, replacing 'General' from `Comb Rev & Expend Page 2`) is labeled `GENERAL SUPPORT SERVICES`, while `J6` is `Total`. Rows `C15:C27` contain 13 rows: the 9 General Support Services items (`C15:C23`) PLUS 4 other top-level expenditure functions (`C24: Maintenance of Plant`, `C25: Community Services`, `C26: Debt Services`, `C27: Other Misc`), with `D29` labeled `TOTAL EXPENDITURES` (`=SUM(D15:D27) = 64,262,879.30`).

In the reference answer (`gt_122_ref_0.xlsx`), the bottom chart (`xl/charts/chart6.xml`) and added percentage formulas (`'4'!K15:K27 = D15/$D$29`) use Sheet `4` cells `C15:C27` and `D15:D27` (all 13 rows in Column D, which is only the General Fund column and includes `Maintenance of Plant`, `Community Services`, `Debt Services`, and `Other Misc` that are separate top-level functions in the top chart, not sub-items of General Support Services) and leaves the chart title blank (`t=''` with series name `'GENERAL SUPPORT SERVICES'`). Because the grader guidance (`problems-metadata.json`, 'Data Accuracy' / `correctness`) instructs the judge to check every modified cell and chart against the reference answer for logical equivalence (`score: 0 or 1`), a competent agent that plots only the 9 actual General Support Services rows (`C15:C23` or `Comb Rev & Expend Page 2` rows `24:32`), or uses the All Funds `Total` column (`J`) instead of Column `D` on Sheet `4`, will diverge from the reference answer on slice count (9 vs. 13), values (`57,389,846.70` or `130,915,235.42` vs. `64,262,879.30`), and percentage locations.
confirmation: The prompt asks for 'all rows that belong to the General Support Services function'. General Exp Page 4 rows 19-27 hold the 9 such items (total 57,389,846.70), but the reference plots '4'!C15:D27 (13 rows, total 64,262,879.30), so a correct 9-slice chart diverges from the key.
fix: Reference gt_122_ref_0.xlsx: the bottom General Support Services pie (chart6.xml) now plots only the 9 General Support Services items, '4'!C15:C23 / D15:D23 (Board Office through Operation of Plant, total 57,389,846.70). The four other functions (Maintenance of Plant, Community Services, Debt Services, Other Misc) are gone, with their cached points, dPt and dLbl entries removed. The helper percentages '4'!K15:K23 now divide by SUM($D$15:$D$23) instead of D29 (e.g. Operation of Plant 32%, School Adm 24%), K24:K27 are cleared, and calcChain is updated to match. Direct XML edit, no other cell or chart changed. The LibreOffice render shows the 9-slice pie.
